answer.reason: The Thessalonica verses add one event beyond the summary, his release after the rulers took security of him, while the Romans verse only gives a greeting.

clauses.english: was let go by the rulers after they took security of him
clauses.quote: they had taken security of Jason, and of the other, they let them go

doubts: ROM 16:21 is only a greeting from a Jason, and it may be a different man, so it was left out.
The dragging before the rulers is already in the summary, so it was not repeated as a clause.
